$comment: Golden briefs for the Editorial Producer pilot harness. answers are keyed by question stage and each is used at most once; a second question at the same stage stops the run as an unanswered checkpoint. expect.status lists acceptable final states; expect.stage pins the stage a paused run must stop at.

briefs.brief: 準備一篇聖誕節文章：讀者要送禮給住在小套房的朋友，優先使用 Formoria 已收錄的商品。

answers.overlap: 另寫一篇獨立的聖誕節文章，角度是適合小空間、不占位的禮物；不要更動既有的 year-end-gifts 或 small-space-reading-corner 路線。

briefs.humanAudit: Spot-check every cited sentence against its excerpt and every provisional selection reason.

briefs.brief: 幫我寫一篇文章，介紹怎麼用台灣品牌的商品打造舒適的工作桌面。
briefs.humanAudit: The pending question must name the existing desk-setup trail and offer maintaining it.

briefs.brief: 寫一篇電動車家用充電樁的選購指南，只用 Formoria 已收錄的商品。

answers.catalog: 不要改變主題。如果型錄裡沒有合適的商品，就直接結束。

briefs.brief: 推薦幾件可以放進洗碗機清洗的台灣品牌餐具，寫成一篇選物文章。
briefs.humanAudit: No sentence may claim dishwasher safety unless an official excerpt states it for that exact product.
